07
workup

Purify three times

For use in seeded growth, purify three times using 1 mL toluene and 1 mL methanol as solvent/nonsolvent. Centrifugation force is 3000 g according to the paragraph-wide condition; cycle duration and final storage solvent/volume are not stated.

Source distinctions and conflicts

  • Do not transfer wurtzite recipe values from the adjacent subsection (350 C, TOP-Se, 5 s).
  • Do not transfer core/shell dimensions, quantum yields or shell-growth temperatures from Table 1 or later subsections.
  • Use ~3 nm/537 nm tied to this exact core-method paragraph. The paper elsewhere identifies 3.1 nm cores for particular shell-growth samples; retain those as separate sample-level observations if needed.
  • Oleylamine is not a reagent in this selected recipe. It can remain a separately labeled molecule reference, but must not be shown as an input to this protocol.
  • The Supporting Information is available locally but does not fill the listed core-procedure omissions.
